# TS9Designs

> TS9Designs is an engineering and building-design firm providing MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing), structural, fire protection, drafting, permit-documentation, construction-plan, and design-coordination services for residential and commercial projects in select U.S. states. Services requiring professional licensure are performed in accordance with the requirements of the applicable jurisdiction.

TS9Designs is not an architecture firm and does not represent itself as providing architectural services.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.ts9designs.com/): overview of services, pricing, and portfolio.
- [About](https://www.ts9designs.com/about.html): firm background and licensure notice.
- [Residential plans](https://www.ts9designs.com/residential.html): pre-designed and custom residential plan offerings.
- [Permit-ready estimate calculator](https://www.ts9designs.com/permit-estimate.html): instant pricing-range estimate tool by project type, square footage, state, scope, and timeline.
- [Case studies](https://www.ts9designs.com/case-studies/index.html): detailed project write-ups (MEP scope, challenges, outcomes) for real completed projects.
- [Desert Shore Community Baptist Church, Bullhead City AZ](https://www.ts9designs.com/case-studies/church-arizona.html): MEP, fire alarm/life safety and structural engineering for a 25,416 sq ft church; approved in plan review.
- [Contact](https://www.ts9designs.com/contact.html): contact form and direct contact details.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ts9designs.com/privacypolicy.html)

## Services

Building Design & Drafting, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Plumbing Engineering, Structural Design, Fire Protection Design, Fire Alarm Plans, Permit Drawings, Construction Documents, Code Coordination, Energy Compliance, 3D Rendering.

## Consultations and how to engage

- Free 15-minute project discovery call for new project inquiries: https://cal.com/ts9designs/discoverycall
- Paid 30-minute Building Design and Engineering Consultation ($99): https://cal.com/ts9designs/engineeringconsultation
- Paid 60-minute Drawing Review Consultation ($199): https://cal.com/ts9designs/60min
- Consultation fees are credited toward a project contract if TS9Designs is hired within 30 days.
- To request a project quote, use the form on the [contact page](https://www.ts9designs.com/contact.html); no paid consultation is required to get pricing.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does TS9Designs do? MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) and structural plans, fire protection and fire alarm design, and permit-ready building design for residential and commercial new construction and renovations.
- How long do engineering plans take? Typically 4-10 days.
- Are the plans code compliant? Plans are prepared to the applicable local building codes and are stamped and sealed where required by the jurisdiction.
- What does a project need to start? Project size, scope (new build or renovation), location and any specific requirements.

## Notes for automated tools / agents

- Pricing shown on the permit-estimate page is a non-binding range; final pricing follows a project-specific review.
- Project photography, drawing samples, and case-study copy on this site describe TS9Designs' own completed work.
- Contact for licensing/scope questions: info@ts9designs.com.
